constraint1:
Constraint 1: Assign each operation of every job to exactly one of its eligible machines.
Constraint 2: Operations within each job must follow their prescribed processing order.
Constraint 3: A machine may process only one operation at a time; operations on the same machine must not overlap.
Constraint 4: The makespan must be at least the completion time of every job.
Constraint 5: All operation start times must be nonnegative.
Constraint 6: Job 2 must be completed no later than time 2000, including completion at 2000.
code1:
# Constraint 6: Job 2 must be completed no later than time 2000, including completion at 2000.
    model.addConstr(B[1, OpNum[1]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[1, OpNum[1]-1, k] * X[1, OpNum[1]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[1, OpNum[1]-1][k] > 0) <= 2000, name="job2_completion_ub")

constraint2:
Constraint 1: Every operation must be allocated to one and only one compatible machine.
Constraint 2: For each job, an operation may start only after its preceding operation has finished.
Constraint 3: Operations assigned to a common machine must be scheduled without overlapping processing intervals.
Constraint 4: The overall completion time cannot be smaller than any individual job's completion time.
Constraint 5: No operation is allowed to start before time zero.
Constraint 6: To meet the delivery timing requirement, Job 3 must finish at or after time 400.
code2:
# Constraint 7: To meet the delivery timing requirement, Job 3 must finish at or after time 400.

constraint3:
Constraint 1: Select exactly one machine from the eligible set for each operation of each job.
Constraint 2: Respect the specified precedence sequence among the operations of a job.
Constraint 3: On any given machine, processing intervals of different operations must be mutually exclusive.
Constraint 4: The makespan must cover the completion of all jobs.
Constraint 5: The start time of every operation must be greater than or equal to zero.
Constraint 6: The completion time of Job 4 must fall between 1400 and 1500, inclusive.

    model.addConstr(B[3, OpNum[3]-1] + quicksum(pt_table[3, OpNum[3]-1, k] * X[3, OpNum[3]-1, k] for k in range(MacNum) if M_table[3, OpNum[3]-1][k] > 0) <= 1500, name="job4_completion_range_ub")

constraint4:
Constraint 1: Each job operation is to be processed on exactly one machine capable of performing it.
Constraint 2: A job's operations must be processed in the required order, with each predecessor completed before its successor starts.
Constraint 3: Each machine has unit capacity and cannot process two operations simultaneously.
Constraint 4: The makespan cannot precede the finishing time of any job.
Constraint 5: Operation start times are restricted to zero or later.
Constraint 6: Job 5 must finish by time 1500; completion exactly at 1500 is acceptable.
code4:

constraint5:

Constraint 2: All operations belonging to the same job must satisfy the given precedence relationships.
Constraint 3: Any two operations processed by the same machine must have non-overlapping processing intervals.
Constraint 4: Every job must finish no later than the makespan.
Constraint 5: Starting an operation at a negative time is prohibited.
Constraint 6: To satisfy the material delivery timing requirement, Job 6 must not finish before time 1600. Completion at 1600 is allowed.

constraint6:
Constraint 1: Each operation must receive exactly one assignment among its compatible machines.
Constraint 2: Within a job, the next operation cannot begin until the previous operation is complete.
Constraint 3: Machine processing must be sequential: no two operations on a machine may run at the same time.
Constraint 4: The makespan is required to be no less than the finishing time of each job.
Constraint 5: The earliest permissible start time for any operation is zero.
Constraint 6: Job 7 must complete within the time window from 1750 to 1850, including both endpoints.

constraint7:

Constraint 2: The prescribed order of operations must be maintained separately for every job.
Constraint 3: Operations sharing a machine must be ordered so that one finishes before or when the next begins.
Constraint 4: The makespan must upper-bound the completion times of all jobs.
Constraint 5: Every operation must have a start time of at least zero.
Constraint 6: To meet the preceding-process coordination requirement, Job 8 must finish no later than time 1700, with equality permitted.

Constraint 3: A machine cannot be occupied by more than one processing operation at any instant.
Constraint 4: The schedule's makespan must be at least as large as each job's completion time.
Constraint 5: All processing start times are constrained to be nonnegative.
Constraint 6: Job 9 cannot finish earlier than time 1550; completion exactly at 1550 satisfies the requirement.
